papers.title: Short-term outcomes of the hinotori versus da Vinci robotic surgical systems in colorectal cancer surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Direct comparative evidence on the hinotori and da Vinci robotic systems in colorectal cancer surgery remains limited. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to compare their short-term perioperative outcomes. PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies directly comparing hinotori with da Vinci robotic surgery in patients with colorectal cancer. Study-level data were pooled using random-effects models, with mean differences (MDs) for continuous outcomes and odds ratios (ORs) for dichotomous outcomes, each with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Five retrospective propensity-score-matched studies involving 462 patients (hinotori, n = 204; da Vinci, n = 258) were included. Operative time (MD 30.57 min, 95% CI 17.51-43.64; I² = 0%) and console time (MD 30.72 min, 95% CI 17.29-44.16; I² = 42%) were significantly longer with hinotori, whereas length of hospital stay was significantly shorter (MD - 1.58 days, 95% CI - 2.92 to - 0.24; I² = 63%). No statistically significant differences were detected for estimated blood loss (MD 3.42 mL, 95% CI - 6.98 to 13.82; I² = 66%) or for postoperative complications (grade I-II: OR 0.78, 95% CI 0.36-1.69; grade III-IV: OR 0.54, 95% CI 0.16-1.76; overall: OR 0.74, 95% CI 0.37-1.46). In this meta-analysis of propensity-score-matched studies, hinotori was associated with longer operative and console times and a shorter hospital stay than da Vinci, whereas no statistically significant difference was detected in blood loss or postoperative complications. Because clinically important differences in safety could not be excluded and residual confounding could not be ruled out, these findings should be regarded as preliminary; larger prospective comparative studies are warranted.

papers.abstract_zh: 在大腸直腸癌手術中，直接比較 hinotori 與 da Vinci 機器人系統的證據仍然有限。我們進行系統性回顧與統合分析，比較兩者的短期圍手術期結果。我們搜尋 PubMed、Embase、Web of Science 及 Cochrane Library，納入直接比較大腸直腸癌病人接受 hinotori 與 da Vinci 機器人手術的研究。研究層級資料採隨機效應模型合併，連續型結果使用平均差（MD），二元結果使用勝算比（OR），並分別提供95%信賴區間（CI）。共納入5篇回溯性傾向分數配對研究，涵蓋462名病人（hinotori：204人；da Vinci：258人）。hinotori 組的手術時間（MD 30.57分鐘，95% CI 17.51至43.64；I²＝0%）及控制台操作時間（MD 30.72分鐘，95% CI 17.29至44.16；I²＝42%）顯著較長，但住院天數顯著較短（MD −1.58天，95% CI −2.92至−0.24；I²＝63%）。估計失血量（MD 3.42 mL，95% CI −6.98至13.82；I²＝66%）及術後併發症（第I–II級：OR 0.78，95% CI 0.36至1.69；第III–IV級：OR 0.54，95% CI 0.16至1.76；整體：OR 0.74，95% CI 0.37至1.46）均未偵測到統計上顯著差異。在這項納入傾向分數配對研究的統合分析中，相較於 da Vinci，hinotori 與較長的手術及控制台操作時間，以及較短的住院天數相關，而失血量及術後併發症未偵測到統計上顯著差異。由於無法排除安全性方面具有臨床重要性的差異，也無法排除殘餘混雜，這些發現應視為初步結果；仍需更大型的前瞻性比較研究。

papers.title: Microplastics and colorectal cancer: presence in human colorectal tissues and associations with tumor biology
papers.authors: Kiani M, Yaqub S, Rasheed H
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The incidence and death rates of colorectal cancer (CRC), one of the world's largest health issues, are rising. These days, environmental contaminants such microplastics (MPs) are believed to play a role in the development of colorectal cancer. Small plastic particles (less than 5 mm) are referred to as MPs because they are persistent and may build up in human tissues, raising questions about their potential involvement in tumour biology.
OBJECTIVE: The objective is to systematically assess the prevalence of microplastics found in human colorectal membranes and their connections to biological processes and tumour type indicators in colorectal cancer.
METHODS: A systematic review was carried out using the Preferred Reporting Items of Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA). Peer-reviewed study sources published between January 2019 and December 2025 were located in MEDLINE, EMBASE, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library. The studies had to assess MPs in human colorectal tumours or surrounding tissues, as well as their associations with tumour biology, such as clinical, inflammatory, or molecular markers, according to the inclusion criteria. Two reviewers worked independently on the screening, selection, and data extraction processes. Thirteen papers make up the final qualitative synthesis, which is screened for full text and title/abstract. Study design, sample size, tissue type, MP detection techniques, polymer type, particle size, and tumour biology outcomes were among the data that were extracted.
RESULTS: Particularly, MPs were detected in colon tissues, and their concentration was greater in tumour tissues than in nearby or control tissues. The most common polymers were polyethylene, polypropylene, and polystyrene, the majority of which were less than 100 μm. The advanced tumour stage, limited differentiation, elevated pro-inflammatory cytokine levels, signs of oxidative stress, disrupted immune infiltration, and disrupted epithelial barrier function were all associated with higher MP loads. According to mechanistic research, MPs can induce oxidative stress, inflammation, and immunological homeostasis, all of which can result in a pro-tumorigenic environment.
CONCLUSION: MPs can affect the development of colorectal cancer (CRC) because they are found in human colorectal tissues and are preferentially accumulated in tumours. Multicenter studies with typical application are required to clarify causal processes and clinical consequences.
papers.title_zh: 微塑膠與大腸直腸癌：人體大腸直腸組織中的存在及其與腫瘤生物學的關聯
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：大腸直腸癌（CRC）是全球重大的健康問題之一，其發生率與死亡率正在上升。目前認為，微塑膠（MPs）等環境污染物可能參與大腸直腸癌的發展。微塑膠是指小於 5 mm 的塑膠微粒，由於具有持久性且可能累積於人體組織，因此引發其是否參與腫瘤生物學的疑問。
目的：系統性評估人體大腸直腸膜組織中微塑膠的檢出情形，以及其與大腸直腸癌生物學過程和腫瘤類型指標之間的關聯。
方法：依據系統性回顧與統合分析優先報告項目（PRISMA）進行系統性回顧。於 MEDLINE、EMBASE、Web of Science 與 Cochrane Library 搜尋 2019 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月發表的同儕審查研究。依納入標準，研究必須評估人體大腸直腸腫瘤或周邊組織中的微塑膠，以及其與腫瘤生物學的關聯，例如臨床、發炎或分子標記。兩位審查者獨立進行篩選、研究選取及資料擷取。經標題／摘要與全文篩選後，最終有 13 篇論文納入定性綜合分析。擷取資料包括研究設計、樣本數、組織類型、微塑膠檢測技術、聚合物種類、粒徑及腫瘤生物學結果。
結果：值得注意的是，結腸組織中可檢出微塑膠，且腫瘤組織中的濃度高於鄰近組織或對照組織。最常見的聚合物為聚乙烯、聚丙烯與聚苯乙烯，多數微粒小於 100 μm。較高的微塑膠負荷與較晚期的腫瘤分期、較低的分化程度、促發炎細胞激素濃度升高、氧化壓力徵象、免疫浸潤失調及上皮屏障功能受損均有關聯。機制研究指出，微塑膠可誘發氧化壓力、發炎及免疫恆定，這些均可能形成促腫瘤環境。
結論：由於微塑膠存在於人體大腸直腸組織，且優先累積於腫瘤中，因此可能影響大腸直腸癌的發展。需要具典型應用的多中心研究，以釐清因果過程及臨床影響。
papers.score_reason: 有系統性搜尋與雙人獨立審查，但摘要未提供總樣本數、偏誤風險評估或定量效應。題目具探索價值，目前對台灣大腸直腸外科決策的直接實用性有限。

papers.title: Cancer Risks Associated With Germline BARD1 Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic Variants: A Multicenter Study of 445 Families
papers.authors: Homer J, Demeure M, Yao Y, Hanson K, Ramczyk B, Lichtenberg E
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: To estimate the relative and absolute risks (ARs) for ovarian, prostate, male and female breast, pancreatic, biliary tract, and colorectal cancers associated with germline BARD1 pathogenic and likely pathogenic variants (PVs/LPVs) because these risks have not previously been reported from a genotype-first perspective.
METHODS: We performed a secondary retrospective analysis of multicenter data comprising 445 three-generation pedigrees with confirmed BARD1 PVs/LPVs from 25 institutions nationwide. Data were aggregated at the family-relatedness level. The risks were estimated using a Bayesian survival model that incorporated information from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) Program.
RESULTS: We confirmed the previously established increased risk for female breast cancer (relative risk [RR] = 3.53; 95% CI, 1.95 to 5.81; posterior probability [PP] = 0.0040) and found positive associations with female pancreatic cancer (RR = 3.76 [95% CI, 2.16-7.25]; PP < .0001), male pancreatic cancer (RR = 2.89 [95% CI, 1.66 to 5.61]; PP < .0001), and prostate cancer (RR = 3.02 [95% CI, 1.95 to 4.71]; PP < .0001). The predictive ARs to age 85 were 41.84% (95% CI, 23.09 to 68.91) for female breast cancer, 4.80% (95% CI, 2.76 to 9.25) for female pancreatic cancer, 3.98% (95% CI, 2.29 to 7.73) for male pancreatic cancer, and 36.11% (95% CI, 23.29 to 56.29) for prostate cancer. Risk estimates suggest an association for male breast, ovarian, and female colorectal cancers; however, the clinical significance is unclear, and these findings warrant cautious interpretation. In contrast, we found no evidence of association for biliary tract cancer or male colorectal cancer.
CONCLUSION: These results support BARD1's association with female breast cancer and suggest associations with pancreatic and prostate cancers. These findings have potential implications for genetic counseling and personalized risk management for male and female BARD1 PV/LPV heterozygotes.

papers.title_zh: 生殖細胞系 BARD1 致病／可能致病變異相關的癌症風險：445 個家族的多中心研究
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：估計與生殖細胞系 BARD1 致病及可能致病變異（PVs/LPVs）相關的卵巢癌、攝護腺癌、男性與女性乳癌、胰臟癌、膽道癌及大腸直腸癌之相對風險與絕對風險（ARs），因為過去尚未從基因型優先的角度報告這些風險。
方法：我們對多中心資料進行次級回溯性分析，資料來自全國 25 家機構，包含 445 個確認帶有 BARD1 PVs/LPVs 的三代家系。資料依家族親緣關係層級彙整。風險以納入美國監測、流行病學與最終結果（SEER）計畫資訊的貝氏存活模型估計。
結果：我們確認先前已確立的女性乳癌風險增加（相對風險［RR］＝3.53；95% CI，1.95–5.81；後驗機率［PP］＝0.0040），並發現與女性胰臟癌（RR＝3.76［95% CI，2.16–7.25］；PP＜0.0001）、男性胰臟癌（RR＝2.89［95% CI，1.66–5.61］；PP＜0.0001）及攝護腺癌（RR＝3.02［95% CI，1.95–4.71］；PP＜0.0001）呈正向關聯。預測至 85 歲的絕對風險，女性乳癌為 41.84%（95% CI，23.09–68.91），女性胰臟癌為 4.80%（95% CI，2.76–9.25），男性胰臟癌為 3.98%（95% CI，2.29–7.73），攝護腺癌為 36.11%（95% CI，23.29–56.29）。風險估計提示與男性乳癌、卵巢癌及女性大腸直腸癌存在關聯；然而，其臨床意義尚不清楚，這些發現應審慎解讀。相較之下，我們未發現與膽道癌或男性大腸直腸癌相關的證據。
結論：這些結果支持 BARD1 與女性乳癌的關聯，並提示其與胰臟癌及攝護腺癌存在關聯。這些發現可能影響男性及女性 BARD1 PV/LPV 異型合子帶因者的遺傳諮詢與個人化風險管理。

papers.relevance_why: 涉及遺傳性癌症諮詢與大腸直腸癌風險，但主要明確訊號來自乳癌、胰臟癌及攝護腺癌。

papers.title: Self-reported operative exposure and autonomy among surgical trainees at selected centers in France and Morocco: a multicenter survey
papers.authors: Michot N, Souadka A, Soufi M, Sabbagh C, Lahnaoui O, Venara A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The expansion of minimally invasive surgery has transformed surgical practice and training worldwide. However, operative exposure to laparoscopic and open procedures may vary across healthcare systems. Comparative international data on operative autonomy and procedural experience during surgical residency remain limited. This study aimed to compare operative exposure, autonomy, and trainee perceptions regarding open and laparoscopic surgery among surgical trainees at selected centers in France and Morocco.
METHODS: A multicenter cross-sectional survey was conducted among surgical trainees at academic centers in France and Morocco. Participants were stratified by postgraduate year (PGY 1-8). Self-reported operative exposure and autonomy were assessed for common general surgical procedures (appendectomy, cholecystectomy, and inguinal hernia repair) and complex colorectal procedures (colectomy and proctectomy) performed using open and laparoscopic approaches. Trainee perceptions of preparedness for minimally invasive surgery and the value of prior training in open surgery were also evaluated. Comparisons were made according to country and level of training.
RESULTS: A total of 131 trainees participated, including 67 from Morocco and 64 from France. Trainees at French centers reported significantly greater exposure to laparoscopic procedures across training levels (p < 0.001), whereas trainees at Moroccan centers reported greater exposure to open appendectomy, inguinal hernia repair, and proctectomy (p < 0.001). Operative autonomy increased with training seniority in both groups, although trainees at French centers reported greater autonomy in laparoscopic procedures. Trainees at Moroccan centers were significantly more likely to consider prior training in open surgery necessary before performing laparoscopic procedures (p < 0.01).
CONCLUSIONS: These findings support context-adapted curricula that preserve competence in open surgery while expanding access to structured, supervised training in minimally invasive surgery.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：微創手術的普及已改變全球的外科實務與訓練。然而，不同醫療體系中，腹腔鏡與開放手術的參與經驗可能有所差異。目前，關於外科住院醫師訓練期間手術自主程度與術式經驗的跨國比較資料仍然有限。本研究旨在比較法國與摩洛哥部分中心外科受訓醫師的手術參與經驗、自主程度，以及對開放與腹腔鏡手術的看法。
方法：本研究於法國與摩洛哥的學術中心，針對外科受訓醫師進行多中心橫斷面問卷調查。參與者依畢業後訓練年資（PGY 1–8）分層。針對以開放及腹腔鏡方式進行的常見一般外科手術（闌尾切除術、膽囊切除術及腹股溝疝氣修補術），以及複雜大腸直腸手術（結腸切除術及直腸切除術），評估受訓醫師自陳的手術參與經驗與自主程度。此外，也評估受訓醫師對自身執行微創手術準備程度的看法，以及先前接受開放手術訓練的價值。研究依國家與訓練階段進行比較。
結果：共131名受訓醫師參與，其中67名來自摩洛哥，64名來自法國。法國中心受訓醫師在各訓練階段均回報顯著較多的腹腔鏡手術參與經驗（p<0.001）；摩洛哥中心受訓醫師則回報較多的開放式闌尾切除術、腹股溝疝氣修補術及直腸切除術參與經驗（p<0.001）。兩組的手術自主程度皆隨訓練年資增加而提升，但法國中心受訓醫師回報的腹腔鏡手術自主程度較高。摩洛哥中心受訓醫師認為執行腹腔鏡手術前必須先接受開放手術訓練的比例顯著較高（p<0.01）。
結論：這些發現支持依當地情境調整訓練課程，在維持開放手術能力的同時，增加接受結構化且有督導之微創手術訓練的機會。

papers.title: 2-methylbutanal remodels arachidonic acid metabolism and antitumor immunity through ENO1 in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Kam S, Song B, Chen Z, Liu J, Cai S, Li B
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Active aldehydes are increasingly recognized as bioactive metabolites, but their roles in tumor immune regulation remain poorly defined. In colorectal cancer (CRC), prostaglandin metabolism contributes to immune suppression, whereas its upstream metabolic regulators are incompletely understood. Here, we investigated 2-methylbutanal (2-MBTL), a branched-chain small-molecule aldehyde, in CRC.
METHODS: The antitumor and immunoregulatory effects of 2-methylbutanal (2-MBTL) were examined in CRC cell systems and mouse models. Its molecular target and downstream pathway were investigated using target-identification assays, RNA interaction analyses, genetic manipulation, transcriptomic profiling, and PGE2 supplementation.
RESULTS: 2-MBTL suppressed CRC growth at well-tolerated doses, increased tumor immunogenic signals, enhanced intratumoral CD8⁺ T-cell infiltration and effector activity, and reduced suppressive myeloid populations. Its direct antiproliferative effect was limited, whereas its antitumor activity was markedly weakened in immunodeficient mice or after CD8⁺ T-cell depletion. Mechanistically, 2-MBTL bound ENO1 and impaired its association with YAP1 mRNA, reducing YAP1 protein expression without substantially altering ENO1 abundance or glycolysis-associated readouts. This was accompanied by increased HPGD expression and reduced PGE2 levels. ENO1 overexpression attenuated the effects of 2-MBTL, while exogenous PGE2 partially reversed tumor suppression and immune remodeling. In human CRC tissues, ENO1 and HPGD showed opposing associations with CD8⁺ T-cell infiltration and survival. 2-MBTL also enhanced the efficacy of PD-1 blockade.
CONCLUSIONS: 2-MBTL promotes CD8⁺ T-cell-dependent antitumor immunity by modulating ENO1-associated post-transcriptional regulation and suppressing YAP1-related PGE2 metabolism.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：活性醛類日益被認為是具有生物活性的代謝物，但其在腫瘤免疫調節中的角色仍未明確。在大腸直腸癌（CRC）中，前列腺素代謝會促進免疫抑制，但其上游代謝調控因子尚未完全釐清。本研究探討支鏈小分子醛類2-methylbutanal（2-MBTL）在CRC中的作用。
方法：在CRC細胞系統與小鼠模型中，檢驗2-methylbutanal（2-MBTL）的抗腫瘤及免疫調節作用。利用標的鑑定試驗、RNA交互作用分析、基因操作、轉錄體分析及PGE2補充實驗，研究其分子標的與下游路徑。
結果：2-MBTL在耐受性良好的劑量下抑制CRC生長、增加腫瘤免疫原性訊號、提升腫瘤內CD8⁺ T細胞浸潤與效應活性，並減少具免疫抑制作用的髓系細胞族群。其直接抑制細胞增殖的作用有限；在免疫缺陷小鼠中或耗竭CD8⁺ T細胞後，其抗腫瘤活性則明顯減弱。在機轉上，2-MBTL與ENO1結合，削弱ENO1與YAP1 mRNA的結合，降低YAP1蛋白表現，但未大幅改變ENO1含量或糖解作用相關檢測指標。上述變化伴隨HPGD表現增加及PGE2濃度降低。ENO1過度表現會削弱2-MBTL的作用，而外源性PGE2可部分逆轉腫瘤抑制及免疫重塑。在人類CRC組織中，ENO1與HPGD各自與CD8⁺ T細胞浸潤及存活呈相反方向的關聯。2-MBTL也增強了PD-1阻斷治療的療效。
結論：2-MBTL藉由調節ENO1相關的轉錄後調控，並抑制YAP1相關的PGE2代謝，促進依賴CD8⁺ T細胞的抗腫瘤免疫。

papers.title: Oculomics in Gastrointestinal Disorders: A narrative review
papers.authors: Morya A, Khullar S, Udenia H, Hingorani-Bang P, Walia S, Manchanda P
papers.abstract:
AIM: We reviewed various ocular biomarkers relevant to gastrointestinal (GI) disorders and examined the potential role of artificial intelligence (AI) in detecting, integrating, and translating these biomarkers into clinical gastroenterology practice.
METHODS: A literature search from PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, Google Scholar, and Web of Science from the year 2000 up to February 2026 was conducted. We included published articles on ocular findings in gastrointestinal disorders and/or AI-based analysis of ocular biomarkers with gastrointestinal connections. Results suggested a positive correlation between AI-based ocular biomarkers and GI disorders.
RESULTS: After reviewing the literature, we found that the most frequently described ocular biomarkers were retinal vascular caliber and arteriovenous ratio on fundus photography; retinal nerve fibre layer and choroidal changes on optical coherence tomography; and vessel-density changes on optical coherence tomography angiography. The persistent signal came from inflammatory bowel disease and steatotic liver disease. AI may improve image processing, feature extraction, and pattern recognition, but more multicentric studies are needed to establish definitive analogy.
DISCUSSION: This review suggests that ocular biomarkers could provide a simple, non-invasive way to identify and monitor gastrointestinal diseases, especially inflammatory bowel disease and steatotic liver disease. Changes in retinal blood vessels, the retinal nerve fibre layer, the choroid, and OCTA-derived vessel density may reflect the inflammation, metabolic disturbances, and small-vessel changes associated with these conditions. However, these findings should be interpreted with caution because many existing studies included small or selected patient groups, used cross-sectional designs, applied different imaging methods, and did not consistently account for factors such as age, vascular risk, medications, or coexisting eye disease. Artificial intelligence may improve the analysis of complex eye images by identifying subtle patterns. Still, high model performance alone does not prove that these tools are accurate, reliable, or specific enough for clinical use. Future studies should therefore include large, multicentre, prospective populations, standardized imaging and reporting methods, independent external validation, and clinically meaningful outcomes. These steps will help determine whether AI-assisted oculomics can reliably support gastrointestinal screening, disease classification, risk assessment, and long-term monitoring.
CONCLUSIONS: Various ocular biomarkers offer a promising, non-invasive approach to studying the deeper nuances of gastrointestinal disease. AI may help scale early biomarker detection and avoid gaps in analysis. Still, routine clinical use will require better external validation, clearer reporting standards, and prospective translational studies.
papers.title_zh: 腸胃疾病中的眼部體學（Oculomics）：敘述性綜述
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：我們回顧了與腸胃道（GI）疾病相關的各種眼部生物標記，並探討人工智慧（AI）在偵測、整合這些生物標記，以及將其轉譯至臨床腸胃醫學實務中的潛在角色。
方法：於 PubMed、MEDLINE、Scopus、Google Scholar 及 Web of Science 進行文獻搜尋，涵蓋期間為 2000 年至 2026 年 2 月。我們納入探討腸胃疾病眼部表現，及／或以 AI 分析與腸胃疾病相關眼部生物標記的已發表文章。結果顯示，AI 分析的眼部生物標記與 GI 疾病呈正相關。
結果：回顧文獻後，我們發現最常被描述的眼部生物標記包括：眼底攝影中的視網膜血管管徑與動靜脈比；光學同調斷層掃描中的視網膜神經纖維層及脈絡膜變化；以及光學同調斷層血管攝影中的血管密度變化。持續可見的訊號來自發炎性腸道疾病與脂肪性肝病。AI 可能改善影像處理、特徵擷取及模式辨識，但仍需更多多中心研究，以確立明確的對應關係。
討論：本綜述指出，眼部生物標記可能提供簡單、非侵入性的方法，用於辨識與監測腸胃疾病，尤其是發炎性腸道疾病與脂肪性肝病。視網膜血管、視網膜神經纖維層、脈絡膜，以及 OCTA 所測得血管密度的變化，可能反映這些疾病相關的發炎、代謝紊亂與小血管變化。然而，這些發現應審慎解讀，因為許多現有研究納入的病人族群規模小或經過篩選、採用橫斷面設計、使用不同影像方法，且未一致控制年齡、血管風險、藥物或共存眼部疾病等因素。人工智慧可能藉由辨識細微模式，改善複雜眼部影像的分析。然而，單憑模型表現優異，並不能證明這些工具具有足供臨床使用的準確性、可靠性或特異性。因此，未來研究應納入大型、多中心、前瞻性族群，採用標準化影像與報告方法、獨立外部驗證，以及具臨床意義的結果指標。這些步驟將有助於判定，AI 輔助眼部體學能否可靠地支援腸胃疾病篩檢、疾病分類、風險評估與長期監測。
結論：各種眼部生物標記為研究腸胃疾病更深層的細微特徵，提供了具潛力的非侵入性途徑。AI 可能有助於擴大早期生物標記偵測的應用規模，並避免分析上的缺漏。然而，常規臨床使用仍需更完善的外部驗證、更明確的報告標準，以及前瞻性轉譯研究。

papers.title: Incidence of Colorectal Cancer After Endoscopic Mucosal Resection: A Multicenter Electronic Health Record Cohort Study
papers.authors: Eldesouki M, Elfert K, Ibrahim E, Youssef M, Shaukat A, Thakkar S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Endoscopic mucosal resection (EMR) is widely used for large and complex colorectal lesions and offers a less invasive alternative to surgery. Although adenoma recurrence after EMR has been described in procedural cohorts, real-world estimates of subsequent colorectal cancer (CRC) diagnoses after EMR across multicenter electronic health record (EHR) systems remain limited.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network. Patients aged 40 years or older who underwent colonoscopy or sigmoidoscopy with EMR between January 1, 2016 and January 1, 2017 were included. Patients with Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, familial adenomatous polyposis, or CRC recorded on or before the index EMR date were excluded. The primary outcome was incident CRC, defined by ICD-10-CM codes C18, C19, and C20, assessed from January 1, 2018 through December 31, 2021 after a one-year washout period. Incidence rates are reported per 1,000 person-years with exact Poisson 95% confidence intervals (CIs). A sensitivity analysis was restricted to patients aged 50-75 years at index EMR.
RESULTS: Among 3,081 eligible patients, the mean age was 62.9 ± 8.89 years and 52% were female; 2,735 were at risk at the start of follow-up. Twenty-two incident CRC diagnoses occurred over 10,187.8 person-years, an incidence of 2.16 per 1,000 person-years (95% CI, 1.35-3.27). Each calendar year contained 10 or fewer events, so annual rates could not be estimated. Incidence was 2.54 (95% CI, 1.31-4.44) in males and 1.83 (95% CI, 0.88-3.36) in females. In the 50-75-year sensitivity cohort, 19 events occurred over 8,894.8 person-years (2.14 per 1,000 person-years; 95% CI, 1.29-3.34). During years 1-5 after index EMR, repeat EMR occurred in 119 patients (3.9%), colorectal surgery in 28 (0.9%), and subsequent colorectal polyp diagnoses in 1,321 (42.9%); no ESD procedures were identified.
CONCLUSION: CRC diagnoses after EMR were uncommon in this multicenter EHR cohort, occurring at about 2 per 1,000 person-years. Event counts were too small to estimate annual trends or to compare incidence reliably across race and ethnicity groups. Studies linking EHR data to endoscopy and pathology reports are needed to identify preventable cancers after EMR.

papers.title_zh: 內視鏡黏膜切除術後的大腸直腸癌發生率：多中心電子病歷世代研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：內視鏡黏膜切除術（EMR）廣泛用於大型及複雜的大腸直腸病灶，是相較於手術侵入性較低的替代治療。雖然已有操作相關世代研究描述EMR後的腺瘤復發，但跨多中心電子病歷（EHR）系統、針對EMR後續大腸直腸癌（CRC）診斷的真實世界估計仍然有限。
方法：我們使用TriNetX美國協作網絡進行回溯性世代研究。納入2016年1月1日至2017年1月1日期間，接受大腸鏡或乙狀結腸鏡合併EMR、年齡40歲以上的病人。排除患有克隆氏症、潰瘍性結腸炎、家族性腺瘤性息肉症，或在指標EMR日期當天及之前已有CRC紀錄的病人。主要結果為新發CRC，以ICD-10-CM代碼C18、C19及C20定義；經一年洗除期後，於2018年1月1日至2021年12月31日期間評估。發生率以每1,000人年呈現，並提供精確Poisson 95%信賴區間（CI）。敏感度分析限於指標EMR時年齡50–75歲的病人。
結果：3,081名符合資格的病人平均年齡為62.9 ± 8.89歲，女性占52%；追蹤開始時有2,735人處於風險中。在10,187.8人年的追蹤期間，共出現22例新發CRC診斷，發生率為每1,000人年2.16例（95% CI，1.35–3.27）。各曆年的事件數均為10例以下，因此無法估計年度發生率。男性發生率為每1,000人年2.54例（95% CI，1.31–4.44），女性為1.83例（95% CI，0.88–3.36）。在50–75歲的敏感度分析世代中，8,894.8人年內發生19例事件，發生率為每1,000人年2.14例（95% CI，1.29–3.34）。指標EMR後第1–5年間，119名病人（3.9%）再次接受EMR，28名（0.9%）接受大腸直腸手術，1,321名（42.9%）後續被診斷有大腸直腸息肉；未辨識出任何ESD處置。
結論：在此多中心EHR世代中，EMR後的CRC診斷並不常見，約為每1,000人年2例。事件數太少，無法估計年度趨勢，也無法可靠比較不同種族及族裔群體的發生率。未來需要將EHR資料與內視鏡及病理報告連結的研究，以辨識EMR後可預防的癌症。

papers.title: Colonoscopy-based Clostridioides difficile screening for inflammatory bowel disease patients
papers.authors: Allegretti J, Carlin A, McClure E, Delaney M, Bry L
papers.abstract: Patients with IBD have an increased risk for Clostridioides difficile infection, and the significance of asymptomatic colonization is poorly understood. Overlapping symptoms often complicate diagnosis, and there is a lack of validated screening methods. Colonic wash aspirates collected during routine colonoscopies may offer a convenient screening option. We aimed to evaluate culture methods for detecting C. difficile colonization in IBD patients using colonic wash samples. Patients with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis undergoing outpatient colonoscopy were enrolled. Clinical characteristics, IBD activity indices, and endoscopic scores were recorded. Colonic wash aspirates were centrifuged and cultured on selective CHROMID® media with and without broth enrichment. Isolates were confirmed by Gram stain and MALDI-TOF. PCR/qPCR identified tcdB gene carriage. Whole-genome sequencing was performed on selected isolates, and associations between clinical factors and colonization were assessed. Of the 121 patients enrolled, 10.7% (13/121) were colonized. Crohn's patients were colonized more frequently than ulcerative colitis patients (13.3% CD, 8.2% UC). Among colonized patients, 53.8% (7/13) had C. difficile with detectable tcdB. Enrichment increased detection compared to direct plating. No clinical predictors of colonization were identified, but wash samples yielded sufficient DNA for sequencing with comparable depth to whole stool. Colonoscopy wash aspirates allow for the detection of asymptomatic C. difficile colonization in IBD. This screening method may provide a useful tool for investigating the prevalence, persistence, and clinical significance of C. difficile colonization in IBD and for informing future studies of CDI prevention.

papers.title_zh: 以大腸鏡沖洗液進行發炎性腸道疾病患者的困難梭菌篩檢
papers.abstract_zh: IBD患者發生困難梭菌感染的風險較高，而無症狀定殖的意義仍不清楚。症狀重疊常使診斷更加困難，且目前缺乏經驗證的篩檢方法。在常規大腸鏡檢查期間採集的結腸沖洗抽吸液，可能提供一種便利的篩檢選項。本研究旨在評估使用結腸沖洗液樣本偵測IBD患者困難梭菌定殖的培養方法。研究納入接受門診大腸鏡檢查的克隆氏症或潰瘍性結腸炎患者，並記錄其臨床特徵、IBD疾病活動指數及內視鏡評分。將結腸沖洗抽吸液離心後，分別以有及無肉湯增菌的方式，在選擇性CHROMID®培養基上培養。分離菌株以革蘭氏染色及MALDI-TOF確認。使用PCR/qPCR鑑定是否帶有tcdB基因。對選定菌株進行全基因體定序，並評估臨床因素與定殖之間的關聯。納入的121名患者中，10.7%（13/121）有定殖。克隆氏症患者的定殖比例高於潰瘍性結腸炎患者（CD為13.3%，UC為8.2%）。在有定殖的患者中，53.8%（7/13）的困難梭菌可檢出tcdB。與直接接種培養相比，增菌提高了檢出率。未找出定殖的臨床預測因子，但沖洗液樣本可提供足夠的DNA供定序使用，且定序深度與完整糞便樣本相當。大腸鏡沖洗抽吸液可用於偵測IBD患者的無症狀困難梭菌定殖。此篩檢方法可能是研究IBD患者困難梭菌定殖盛行率、持續性及臨床意義的實用工具，並可為未來CDI預防研究提供參考。

papers.title: ECCO Topical Review: Inflammatory Bowel Disease-Like Patterns of Drug Colitis with Practical Guidance and a Focus on Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Induced Enterocolitis
papers.authors: Verstockt B, Dragoni G, van Schaik F, Nunes P, Burisch J, Carbonnel F
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Drug-induced enterocolitis (DIC) consists of a heterogeneous group of gastrointestinal inflammatory disorders with clinical, endoscopic, and histological features that often overlap with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Given the increasing recognition of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-induced enterocolitis and the lack of standardized management algorithms, the European Crohn's and Colitis Organisation (ECCO) convened a multidisciplinary panel to review DIC, with a particular focus on ICI-induced disease.
METHODS: Gastroenterologists, histopathologists, and oncologists systematically reviewed the literature using Medline, PubMed, EMBASE, and Scopus. Evidence was synthesized into ECCO Current Practice Positions addressing diagnostic principles, histopathological patterns, therapeutic strategies, and ICI-specific considerations. Statements were refined and approved through structured consensus.
RESULTS: Twenty-three practice positions were agreed upon. DIC may present with diverse histological patterns, including IBD-like/chronic enterocolitis, acute enterocolitis, microscopic colitis, ischemic-type injury, and mixed features, none of which are pathognomonic. Close clinicopathological collaboration is therefore essential. In suspected ICI-induced enterocolitis, assessment should include Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events-based grading, stool testing for pathogens, fecal calprotectin, endoscopy with biopsies, and imaging when indicated. Corticosteroids remain first-line therapy, while mild or microscopic disease may respond to budesonide or beclomethasone. Corticosteroid-refractory or corticosteroid-dependent disease should prompt early escalation to infliximab or vedolizumab. Surgery is reserved for refractory or complicated cases. Rechallenge with ICIs may be considered following multidisciplinary evaluation.
CONCLUSION: DIC represents a diagnostically complex spectrum of disorders that require integrated multidisciplinary evaluation. These ECCO Current Practice Positions provide a practical framework for diagnostic work-up and treatment, particularly for ICI-induced enterocolitis.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：藥物誘發性腸結腸炎（DIC）包含一群異質性的胃腸道發炎疾病，其臨床、內視鏡及組織學特徵經常與發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）重疊。鑑於免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICI）誘發性腸結腸炎日益受到重視，且缺乏標準化處置流程，歐洲克隆氏症與結腸炎組織（ECCO）召集多專科小組回顧 DIC，特別聚焦於 ICI 誘發的疾病。
方法：胃腸科醫師、組織病理科醫師及腫瘤科醫師使用 Medline、PubMed、EMBASE 與 Scopus，系統性回顧相關文獻。將證據彙整為 ECCO 現行實務立場，涵蓋診斷原則、組織病理表現、治療策略，以及 ICI 特有的考量。各項聲明經結構化共識程序修訂並核准。
結果：共達成 23 項實務立場。DIC 可呈現多種組織學型態，包括 IBD 樣／慢性腸結腸炎、急性腸結腸炎、顯微性結腸炎、缺血型損傷及混合型表現，但沒有任何一種具有疾病特異性。因此，臨床與病理之間的密切合作至關重要。對於疑似 ICI 誘發性腸結腸炎，評估應包括依據不良事件通用術語標準（CTCAE）進行分級、糞便病原體檢測、糞便鈣衛蛋白、內視鏡合併切片，以及有適應症時進行影像檢查。全身性皮質類固醇仍為第一線治療，而輕症或顯微性疾病可能對 budesonide 或 beclomethasone 有反應。對皮質類固醇治療無反應或依賴皮質類固醇的疾病，應及早升級至 infliximab 或 vedolizumab。手術保留用於難治性或出現併發症的病例。經多專科評估後，可考慮重新使用 ICI。
結論：DIC 是一組診斷複雜的疾病譜，需要整合性的多專科評估。這些 ECCO 現行實務立場提供診斷檢查與治療的實用架構，尤其適用於 ICI 誘發性腸結腸炎。

papers.title: Roles of protein crotonylation in tumors: regulatory mechanisms and therapeutic potential
papers.authors: Liang Y, Liu Q, Yang C, Xun Y, Liu Y, Shen Y
papers.abstract: Lysine crotonylation(Kcr), an important protein post-translational modification, establishes a connection between cellular metabolism and epigenetic regulation. This modification utilizes crotonyl-CoA as a donor and is co-regulated by "writers", "erasers" and "readers". Furthermore, it participates in key biological processes including gene transcription, metabolic reprogramming, DNA damage repair, and remodeling of the tumor immune microenvironment. Recent studies have demonstrated that crotonylation is dysregulated in various malignant tumors, including breast cancer, colorectal cancer, liver cancer, lung cancer, and glioma. It drives tumor proliferation, invasion, metastasis, and drug resistance by influencing metabolic enzyme activity, chromatin status, DNA repair efficiency, and immune signaling pathways. Lysine crotonylation demonstrates significant environmental-dependence across different cancers; Not only can it promote the malignant phenotype of tumor cells, but it can also potentiate the response to immunotherapy under specific metabolic conditions. Preclinical studies have explored therapeutic strategies targeting tumor crotonylation, including metabolic interventions, enzymatic regulation, and combination immunotherapy; however, these approaches remain investigational and have not been clinically validated. This narrative review summarizes the molecular mechanisms, biological functions, and current advances of crotonylation in diverse malignancies, and highlights unresolved questions and emerging therapeutic hypotheses.

papers.abstract_zh: 離胺酸巴豆醯化（Kcr）是一種重要的蛋白質轉譯後修飾，連結細胞代謝與表觀遺傳調控。此修飾以巴豆醯輔酶 A（crotonyl-CoA）作為供體，並由「寫入者」、「去除者」及「辨讀者」共同調控。此外，它參與基因轉錄、代謝重編程、DNA 損傷修復及腫瘤免疫微環境重塑等關鍵生物學過程。近期研究顯示，巴豆醯化在多種惡性腫瘤中出現失調，包括乳癌、大腸直腸癌、肝癌、肺癌及神經膠質瘤。它透過影響代謝酵素活性、染色質狀態、DNA 修復效率及免疫訊息傳遞路徑，驅動腫瘤增殖、侵犯、轉移及抗藥性。離胺酸巴豆醯化在不同癌症中呈現顯著的環境依賴性；它不僅能促進腫瘤細胞的惡性表型，也能在特定代謝條件下增強免疫治療反應。臨床前研究已探索針對腫瘤巴豆醯化的治療策略，包括代謝介入、酵素調控及合併免疫治療；然而，這些方法仍處於研究階段，尚未經過臨床驗證。本敘述性綜述彙整巴豆醯化在各種惡性腫瘤中的分子機轉、生物學功能及目前研究進展，並強調尚未解決的問題與新興治療假說。

papers.title: B cell/adipocyte crosstalk amplifies MCP-1 secretion, M2-like macrophage accumulation, and polarization in gut-associated, inflamed adipose tissue
papers.authors: Goess M, Heinze J, Hofmann J, Buck A, Gadjalova I, Weber M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: During Crohn's disease (CD), hyperplasia of the mesenteric white adipose tissue (WAT), called creeping fat (CrF), is associated with the accumulation of immune cells. Here we investigated the impact of B cell/adipocyte crosstalk on immune cell recruitment and inflammation within inflammatory bowel disease-related adipose tissue.
METHODS: We used flow cytometry and in vitro 3D culture systems of biopsies from CrF of CD patients as well as a mouse model of intestinal inflammation, in vitro co-cultures, mass spectrometry, and single-cell RNA sequencing to evaluate the impact of B cell/adipocyte interplay on monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 (MCP-1) production and macrophage polarization.
RESULTS: Employing primary human and mouse 3D adipocyte cultures, we observed that adipocytes from CD patients displayed a persistent inflammatory phenotype even after prolonged time in culture, a cytokine secretion profile also recapitulated via lipopolysaccharide stimulation. Analyzing CrF of CD patients as well as WAT of a mouse model of intestinal inflammation, we found an accumulation of B cells. B cell/adipocyte co-cultures led to elevated secretion of MCP-1 by primary adipocytes, facilitating macrophage migration. Consequently, co-transfer of B cells with T cells increased T cell activation and M2-like macrophage accumulation in inflamed mouse WAT. Mass spectrometry and single-cell RNA sequencing analyses suggested that the B cell/adipocyte crosstalk establishes a microenvironment that may promote M2-like macrophage polarization.
CONCLUSION: B cell/adipocyte interactions in CD-associated inflamed adipose tissue increase MCP-1 and lactate, promoting recruitment and M2-like polarization of macrophages, likely amplifying local WAT inflammation.
papers.title_zh: B細胞與脂肪細胞的交互作用增強腸道相關發炎脂肪組織中的MCP-1分泌、M2樣巨噬細胞聚集與極化
papers.abstract_zh:
背景與目的：在克隆氏症（CD）中，稱為爬行脂肪（CrF）的腸繫膜白色脂肪組織（WAT）增生，與免疫細胞聚集有關。本研究探討B細胞與脂肪細胞的交互作用，對發炎性腸道疾病相關脂肪組織內免疫細胞募集及發炎的影響。
方法：我們使用流式細胞分析、以CD病人CrF活體組織檢體建立的體外3D培養系統，以及腸道發炎小鼠模型、體外共培養、質譜分析與單細胞RNA定序，評估B細胞與脂肪細胞的交互作用對單核球趨化蛋白-1（MCP-1）生成及巨噬細胞極化的影響。
結果：運用人類與小鼠的原代脂肪細胞3D培養，我們觀察到，來自CD病人的脂肪細胞即使經過長時間培養，仍呈現持續的發炎表型；其細胞激素分泌模式亦可透過脂多醣刺激重現。分析CD病人的CrF及腸道發炎小鼠模型的WAT時，我們發現B細胞聚集。B細胞與脂肪細胞共培養使原代脂肪細胞的MCP-1分泌增加，促進巨噬細胞遷移。隨之，將B細胞與T細胞共同移入小鼠，增加了發炎WAT中的T細胞活化及M2樣巨噬細胞聚集。質譜與單細胞RNA定序分析提示，B細胞與脂肪細胞的交互作用建立了一種可能促進M2樣巨噬細胞極化的微環境。
結論：CD相關發炎脂肪組織中的B細胞與脂肪細胞交互作用，會增加MCP-1及乳酸，促進巨噬細胞募集及M2樣極化，可能進一步放大局部WAT的發炎。

papers.title: Helicobacter pylori and colorectal neoplasia with emphasis on microbial mechanisms and causal evidence
papers.journal_full: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
papers.abstract: Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection is associated with colorectal neoplasia in many observational studies, but a causal relationship and a preventive effect of eradication remain unestablished. This narrative review integrates clinical, microbial, experimental, and treatment evidence using four questions: which infection phenotype was measured, whether exposure preceded the colorectal outcome, whether a proposed intermediate was experimentally perturbed, and whether a defined intervention changed that outcome. Positive observational syntheses contrast with weaker or inconsistent prospective serological and genetic findings. Residual confounding, including socioeconomic and lifestyle differences, and non-equivalent exposure measurements limit causal interpretation. Gastric atrophy, endocrine changes, microbial remodeling, metabolites, and immune responses provide candidate links, but no complete infection-to-neoplasia sequence has been demonstrated in humans. Microbiota-dependent tumor promotion in genetically susceptible mice provides experimental support within that setting, whereas reduced tumor formation in an inflammation-driven model limits generalization. Neither model reproduces the duration and heterogeneity of human infection. Eradication findings depend on comparator selection, sufficient latency, and separation of randomized treatment assignment from successful clearance. A comparative appraisal links each proposed mechanism to its strongest available evidence, unresolved human causal link, and required validation. Infection status alone is not established as a basis for changing colorectal screening or claiming colorectal cancer prevention through eradication. Longitudinal human sampling, targeted tests of candidate intermediates, and long-term intervention analyses with explicit treatment comparisons are needed to establish clinical relevance.

papers.title_zh: 幽門螺旋桿菌與大腸直腸腫瘤：聚焦微生物機轉與因果證據
papers.abstract_zh: 許多觀察性研究顯示，幽門螺旋桿菌（H. pylori）感染與大腸直腸腫瘤相關，但兩者的因果關係及根除治療的預防效果仍未確立。本敘述性綜述透過四個問題，整合臨床、微生物、實驗與治療證據：測量的是哪一種感染表型、暴露是否先於大腸直腸結局發生、是否以實驗方式干預所提出的中介環節，以及明確定義的介入是否改變該結局。觀察性研究的整合結果呈現正向關聯，相較之下，前瞻性血清學與遺傳學研究的結果較弱或不一致。殘餘混雜因素，包括社經與生活型態差異，以及彼此不等同的暴露測量方式，限制了因果解釋。胃萎縮、內分泌變化、微生物群重塑、代謝物與免疫反應提供了可能的連結，但尚未在人類證實從感染到腫瘤形成的完整過程。在具有遺傳易感性的小鼠中，依賴微生物群的腫瘤促進作用，為該特定情境提供實驗支持；然而，在發炎驅動模型中觀察到腫瘤形成減少，限制了結果的推廣性。這兩種模型皆無法重現人類感染的持續時間與異質性。根除治療的研究結果取決於比較組的選擇、是否有足夠的潛伏時間，以及是否區分隨機分派的治療與實際成功清除感染。本文以比較性評析，將各項提出的機轉與其目前最強的可用證據、尚未釐清的人類因果連結，以及所需的驗證相互對照。目前尚未確立僅憑感染狀態即可作為改變大腸直腸篩檢，或宣稱根除治療可預防大腸直腸癌的依據。仍需進行人類縱向採樣、針對候選中介環節的定向測試，以及具有明確治療比較的長期介入分析，才能確立其臨床相關性。

papers.title: From Radical Resection to Organ Preservation in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: A Narrative Review of Risk-Adapted Management
papers.authors: Cetin B, Karaman I, Erdem D, Kaya E, Okumus N
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: To synthesise evidence informing risk-adapted treatment and organ preservation in locally advanced rectal cancer.
METHODS: This narrative review used targeted English-language searches of PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library through 31 March 2026, supplemented by targeted source verification in September 2026.
RESULTS: Magnetic resonance imaging, mismatch repair status, recurrence risk, and patient preferences inform treatment selection. Total neoadjuvant therapy is established for higher-risk mismatch repair-proficient/microsatellite-stable disease. Chemoradiation followed by consolidation chemotherapy can improve organ-preservation probability compared with induction sequencing, without a demonstrated disease-free survival advantage. Selected lower-risk surgical candidates may receive chemotherapy with selective chemoradiation. Both short-course radiotherapy and long-course chemoradiation remain evidence-based options; the long-term locoregional failure signal in RAPIDO cannot be attributed to fractionation alone. Watch-and-wait requires multimodal confirmation of clinical complete response, intensive surveillance, and access to salvage surgery; oncological equivalence to immediate resection is unproven. Prospective dostarlimab data support non-operative management in selected mismatch repair-deficient rectal cancers, while long-term durability requires further evaluation.
CONCLUSION: Management should integrate tumour anatomy, biology, treatment response, and patient priorities. Organ preservation requires careful selection and structured follow-up, with treatment intensity individualised rather than applied uniformly.

papers.title_zh: 從根治性切除到局部進展期直腸癌的器官保留：風險調適管理之敘述性綜述
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：整合可作為局部進展期直腸癌風險調適治療與器官保留依據的證據。
方法：本敘述性綜述針對 PubMed、Embase 與 Cochrane Library 進行英文文獻的定向搜尋，搜尋截止日期為2026年3月31日，並於2026年9月補充進行針對性的來源核實。
結果：磁振造影、錯配修復狀態、復發風險與病人偏好可作為治療選擇的依據。對於較高風險、錯配修復功能正常／微衛星穩定型疾病，全程新輔助治療已是確立的治療方式。相較於先給予誘導化療的順序，化學放射治療後接續鞏固化療可提高器官保留機率，但尚未證實具有無病存活優勢。經篩選的較低風險、適合手術病人，可接受化療並選擇性使用化學放射治療。短程放射治療與長程化學放射治療均仍是有實證支持的選項；RAPIDO 試驗中長期局部區域治療失敗的訊號，不能僅歸因於放射治療分次方式。觀察等待策略需要以多種評估方式確認臨床完全緩解、密集監測，以及可取得救援手術；其腫瘤學結果與立即切除是否相當，尚未獲得證實。Dostarlimab 的前瞻性資料支持在經篩選的錯配修復缺陷型直腸癌病人中採取非手術管理，但療效的長期持續性仍須進一步評估。
結論：管理策略應整合腫瘤解剖特徵、生物學特性、治療反應與病人的優先考量。器官保留需要謹慎篩選病人及結構化追蹤，治療強度應個別化，而非一體適用。
